description: End-to-end greedy speculative decoding on Metal with the MTP draft on the device (ADR 0028): the MTP layer and the draft rows uploaded as a one-block device model, verify passes with rollback (ADR 0026), against plain greedy decode on the same device. Same 8 prompts and settings as metal-m5-speculative.json (ADR 0027, CPU draft). Times are the decode phase only.
command: qwen-rust-inference metal-speculative --library target/metal/libqwen_metal.dylib --model-dir models/qwen --prompt-file spec/measurements/mtp-prompts.txt --max-new-tokens 128 --depth K --draft-vocab N --draft-vocab-text target/mtp-vocab-text.txt (--draft-on device is the default)
